D.t: Brad Lander leads by 74.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 160,477 votes; a one point swing is about 1,076 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +70.6 and D +78.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
